1	// TODO(cloudflare): company-skills.ts reads and writes skill Markdown files
2	// directly on the local host filesystem using node:fs/promises (readdir, stat,
3	// readFile, writeFile, mkdir, rm). Operations include:
4	//   - walkLocalFiles / collectLocalSkillInventory: directory traversal for
5	//     skill file discovery (local_path and catalog source types)
6	//   - readFile: reads SKILL.md and supporting files at request time
7	//   - createLocalSkill / updateFile: writes skill Markdown to disk
8	//   - materializeCatalogSkillFiles / materializeRuntimeSkillFiles: copies skill
9	//     files into a runtime-materialized directory tree
10	// For Workers compatibility the managed skill storage must migrate to R2 (file
11	// contents keyed by companyId/skillId/relativePath), with directory listing
12	// replaced by a database-backed file inventory. Local-path skills referencing
13	// host directories cannot be supported in a stateless Worker deployment.
